game.title: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare
game.blurb: Sci-fi first-person shooter from Infinity Ward, published by Activision, released 2016-11-04. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes: the campaign, its side missions, multiplayer and the five zombies maps the achievements name.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The main operations from Rising Threat and Black Sky to Operation Blood Storm, the hidden campaign feats, and every mission on Veteran. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Ship Boarding and Jackal Side Missions
chapters.summary: The optional ship boarding operations and the Jackal-only operations.

chapters.title: Weapons, Gear and the Most-Wanted Board
chapters.summary: Scanning weapons, custom loadouts, equipment and Jackal upgrades, death letters, the most-wanted board and zero-G kills.

chapters.title: Spaceland
chapters.summary: The Spaceland zombies map: the sticker pack, the Soul Key piece, Brutes, the arcade games and its hidden feats.

chapters.title: Rave in the Redwoods
chapters.summary: The second zombies map named in the achievements: its Soul Key piece, camp badges, ziplines and the Slasher.

chapters.title: Shaolin Shuffle
chapters.summary: The third zombies map named: bios, Chi abilities, newspaper clippings and its Soul Key piece.

chapters.title: Attack of the Radioactive Thing
chapters.summary: The fourth zombies map named: traps, Willard's recordings, the M.A.D. and its Soul Key piece.

chapters.title: The Beast From Beyond
chapters.summary: The fifth zombies map named: its traps and the final piece of the Soul Key. Spoiler-guarded.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Infinite_Warfare
Fandom (callofduty.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Infinite_Warfare
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 292730 ("Call of Duty®: Infinite Warfare"); RAWG's first result is the right game, with a separate free-trial entry and a bundle with Destiny that were not used. 22 of 88 Steam achievements are hidden. They were placed by their position in the Steam list, which runs campaign first and then one zombies map at a time: six hidden ones sit among the campaign extras and stay in the campaign chapter, and the other 16 sit inside the blocks for Spaceland (2), Rave in the Redwoods (1), Shaolin Shuffle (3), Attack of the Radioactive Thing (4) and The Beast From Beyond (6). That placement is a reasoned guess. The zombies map names come only from the achievement text; the Steam data does not say which were added later, so no DLC pack names are given. Nearly all zombies achievements are below 5%; only one achievement is multiplayer ("Dominion", 1.1%). StrategyWiki has a stub at completion stage 0 with no subpages written. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
